about.heading: About
about.studyOnly: OpenRange is a study tool. It does not read your screen, show overlays or HUDs, or connect to any poker site. Hand-history import is for reviewing sessions after you play.
about.offline: Everything runs on this device. There are no accounts, no telemetry, and no network requests after the app has loaded.
about.milestone: This is an early build: the equity calculator works; drills, charts and lessons arrive in later milestones.
equity.heading: Equity calculator
equity.intro: Equity is your share of the pot if all the cards are dealt out with no more betting, counting a split pot as half. Enter a hand (AhKh) or a range (QQ+, AKs, T9s-54s) for each player.
equity.exactNote: Exact: all {runouts} ways to complete the board were checked for every possible matchup (no sampling error).
equity.mcNote: Estimate from {samples} random deals (seed {seed}). The ± value is one standard error: the true equity is within about two of them 95% of the time.
